title: GatewayHeartbeat
description: The E2 body of POST /api/v1/gateways/{id}/heartbeat, contract 1 and 2 (docs/design/discovery-contract.md section 2). A replica sends the contract 2 fields (bound_targets_version, and per Argo CD connector scope_digest, discovery_enabled and discovery_interval_seconds) only after the previous heartbeat response answered contract_version 2. It never carries a URL, a credential, an AppProject name, an Application name or a value derived from snapshot_key.

bound_targets_version.description: Contract 2. The bound_targets_version of the last heartbeat response this replica applied, or the empty string when it has none. The control plane sends bound_targets only when its current version differs.

scope_digest.description: Contract 2, Argo CD connectors only, always sent. SHA-256 over the canonical scope input (ADR 0002 C6; discovery-contract.md section 2.2). The control plane compares it with the approved digest.

discovery_enabled.description: Contract 2, Argo CD connectors only, always sent. The local discovery.enabled switch. It is also inside scope_digest, so flipping it is a scope change.

discovery_interval_seconds.description: Contract 2. The local discovery.interval. Required when discovery_enabled is true, refused otherwise. The control plane grants a lease no sooner than this after the previous grant, and never below 60 seconds.
